candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify the multisystem symptom pattern and course.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Gastrointestinal and cardiorespiratory symptoms should be assessed together.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Broad symptom/course questions count; volunteered sensory symptoms or weight loss need not be separately requested.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek existing evidence characterising the cardiac phenotype.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Breathlessness alone does not establish infiltrative cardiac disease.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Existing echocardiography, cardiac MRI or a relevant comparable cardiac investigation can satisfy this; do not require every modality.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek monoclonal-screening evidence AND a further relevant discriminating/confirmatory investigation route before subtype assignment.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A suspected multisystem syndrome does not by itself establish a final subtype.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Monoclonal/immunofixation/light-chain requests plus an appropriate PYP/nuclear, genetic, biochemical or tissue/typing enquiry are accepted candidate alternatives. TTR requests can count although their result is withheld. Do not require the article's later exact biopsy route; GLA is not a TTR result.

candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: No repeat request is required to rediscover the already-disclosed gap. Requests for appropriate existing reassessment are helpful; newly performing tests was outside the interview task.
